rooms.name: Primary bedroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. King bed with a low headboard on the west wall, centred between the two west windows (W15 and W14, both kept), with a nightstand under each; the rear sliding door W01 opens to the garden. Open to the vestibule at the south-east corner (D10, 4′7″ wide, no door).

rooms.name: Bedroom 2 · main bay
rooms.note: Retained original main-room dimensions. Entry alcove and closet are separate.

rooms.name: Primary bathroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Laid out as on the architect's sheet: a 5′0″ × 3′0″ curbless shower in the north-west corner under the skylight W20, the toilet in the south-west corner, a 6′6″ double vanity along the south wall, the door D08 at the east end of the north wall and the window W13 on the west wall, its mullion on the shower's glass line.

rooms.name: Walk-in closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. An enclosed room off the primary suite's vestibule, behind the sliding pocket door D18 (2′6″ × 6′8″) in its east wall. Hanging rods and shelves on the north, west and south walls, with a drawer and shelf tower on the west wall; no window; flush ceiling light.

rooms.name: Bedroom 4
rooms.note: Clear interior size overall; excludes walls. L-shaped: the laundry closet is taken out of the north-east corner, and the area leaves out 3′4⅜″ × 3′2¼″ for the closet and its two walls. Flat 8 ft ceiling (no vault).

rooms.name: Bedroom 3
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls and the bay, which is glazed to the floor.

rooms.name: Bedroom 3 bathroom
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. The shower window W11 on the west wall is 3′0″ wide and runs from a 3′0″ sill to a 7′6″ head (4′6″ tall), in obscured glass.

rooms.name: Bedroom 3 compact closet
rooms.note: Compact step-in closet. 24-inch hanging depth at west; approximately 45⅝-inch-wide standing bay. Retained 32-inch pocket opening.

rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.note: Clear interior size, from the shared bath's south wall to the front wall. The west wall lines up with the shared bath's east wall.

rooms.name: Bedroom 4 reach-in closet
rooms.note: 24-inch clear storage depth, with a separate 60-inch bypass door opening from Bedroom 4. Divider thickness is excluded. Flat 8 ft ceiling.

rooms.name: Laundry closet
rooms.note: Clear interior size: 2′10″ wide (north to south, across the doors) and 3′0″ deep (door wall to back wall). Carved out of Bedroom 4's north-east corner; it opens east onto the foyer through the doors D17. Stacked front-load washer and dryer, each 27 × 30¼ × 39 in (width × depth × height), facing the foyer, under the 8 ft ceiling.

rooms.name: Primary vestibule
rooms.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. The passage of the primary suite: open to the bedroom over its full width (D10, 4′7″, no door), entered from the hall through D09 in its east wall, with the walk-in closet's pocket door D18 in its west wall and the bathroom door D08 at its south end. Attic access hatch (30 × 22 in) in the ceiling.
